diagnostics.measurement: independent property intensities 0..5; explicit pole statuses; no subtraction or invented antonyms
diagnostics.missing_policy: unknown is NaN, never zero; iteratively filter scales before objects until stable; training gaps mean-imputed; posterior uses only observed coordinates
diagnostics.minimum_coverage_policy: each iteration: first scales observed on at least 60% and 8 current objects and nonconstant; then objects observed on at least 60% and 4 surviving scales; repeat until stable; retained overall coverage at least 75%
diagnostics.preprocessing_report: На каждой итерации сначала исключаются постоянные шкалы и шкалы, измеренные менее чем у 60% текущих объектов или менее чем у 8 объектов. Затем исключаются объекты с оценками менее чем по 60% оставшихся шкал или менее чем по 4 шкалам. Процедура повторяется до стабильности состава. В итоговой матрице требуется не менее 75% известных оценок. Неизвестные значения не заменяются нулём.

multiple_imputation.scope: Each analytical completion refits FA and its scaler. Scores use that completed analytical dataset. Matching loading columns only fixes display orientation and does not change Euclidean distances. Observed source cells are never changed; canonical unknown stays unknown.

stability_design.uncertain_participant_rule: Flag for review if conditional same-cluster fraction <.8 in either experiment, silhouette<0 or descriptive centroid margin<.1. These are heuristic review thresholds, not significance or posterior probabilities of a true group.

limitations: q3 remains an exploratory working hypothesis; previous loading/imputation and strict-source sensitivity findings still apply.
Subsampling evaluates a fixed score geometry, not source accuracy or full factor-selection uncertainty. The ten imputation realizations are descriptive and do not cure MNAR or validate the corpus.
Ward partitions continuous geometry even without natural social classes; silhouette is not the selection rule. Hierarchical ties can depend on the saved object order.
Groups summarize public-property evidence, not private beliefs, causes, shared electorate, social strata or statistical significance.
Only admitted objects receive coordinates; excluded unknown objects are not assigned zero or a guessed group. No sparse Russia block is imputed.
